post.description: Queue EVALUATE_COMPONENT_EXPIRY for AVAILABLE stock in the caller custody whose printed label expiry has been reached. ROLE-01 and ROLE-02 only; institution accounts require operator verification for the inventory:expiry capability. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key replays the original server evaluation time. Acceptance is not ledger commitment; poll the command status. Conflicts: COMPONENT_LABEL_NOT_EXPIRED, COMPONENT_EXPIRY_RESERVATION_ACTIVE (cancel the reservation first), COMPONENT_ALREADY_EXPIRED, COMPONENT_EXPIRY_TRANSITION_INVALID, COMPONENT_VERSION_CONFLICT, V2_1_CONTRACT_REQUIRED, V2_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

ContractVersion.name: x-bloodledger-contract-version
ContractVersion.description: V2 by default. Set V2.1 to enable the additive CRYOPRECIPITATE contract; V2 behavior remains unchanged.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable replay key for this mutation. Reuse only with the identical request payload.

OperatorVerification.name: Operator-Verification
OperatorVerification.description: Two-minute, session/operator/institution/action/body/idempotency-bound grant. A consumed grant accepts only matching retries while the session remains valid.

ComponentTypeV21.description: The additive V2.1 component vocabulary. CRYOPRECIPITATE is rejected by V2.

LocalReleaseRequest.description: Exact request body for POST /local-releases. ROLE-01 and ROLE-02 only. V2.1 allows CRYO. The server freezes globally eligible FEFO members and current versions; canonical chaincode validates them before acceptance. No local-release detail read is exposed.

ReconciliationRequest.description: Exact request body for POST /reconciliation. ROLE-01 and ROLE-02 only.

ReservationActionRequest.description: The endpoint enforces an exact body by action: prepare requires preparedAt, preparedEvidenceDigest and preparedEvidenceId; compromise requires reasonCode; all other actions accept only the base fields.

actionCapabilities.description: UI action visibility only. Server requires a bound PIN grant and validates roles, scope and versions.

invitationSecret.description: Returned once on issuance. Idempotent retry returns null; issue a new invitation if private delivery failed.

safeExplanation.description: Required only when reasonCode is OTHER. Synthetic, redacted explanation only.
Required only when reasonCode is OTHER. Synthetic, redacted explanation only.
Required only when reasonCode is OTHER. Synthetic, redacted explanation only.

ComponentProjection.description: Actual operational V2.1 component projection. V2 list reads omit CRYO. Purpose is read from reservation detail; Donation No. material is excluded. institutionId is the current custodian.

expiryState.description: Read-time comparison of the printed label expiry with the server clock and ledger status; it never changes inventoryStatus. LABEL_EXPIRED_PENDING_EVALUATION is AVAILABLE or RESERVED stock whose label expiry is at or before now; EXPIRED is ledger-evaluated; LABEL_EXPIRED_NOT_IN_INVENTORY covers other statuses past label expiry.

ExpiryEvaluationRequest.description: Exact request body for POST /components/{componentId}/expiry. ROLE-01 and ROLE-02 only. The server sets evaluationTime and eventTime; expectedVersion is the inventoryVersion that was read.

PolicyDisabled.description: Policy or report format is not enabled

Conflict.description: A safe identity or state conflict

Forbidden.description: The authenticated role is outside the permitted scope

CommandTimeOutOfWindow.description: V2_COMMAND_TIME_OUT_OF_WINDOW: a new command eventTime (and requestTime for transfer requests) is more than 300 seconds from the server clock. A retry with an already accepted Idempotency-Key replays the original command unchanged, and an exact operation of the active approved population manifest keeps its recorded time. On this error, discard the attempt and submit a new attempt with a new Idempotency-Key and the current time.
